title: Jail Killing
subtitle: Assassination of national leaders inside prison during regime crisis.
summary: During the post-August 1975 crisis, four national leaders of Bangladesh were assassinated inside Dhaka Central Jail, deepening institutional breakdown and political fear.
heroTagline: Assassination of national leaders inside prison during regime crisis.
whyItMatters: The jail killings became a defining marker of impunity, elite power struggle, and constitutional rupture in post-independence politics.
